Sessions

Every conversation is persisted as JSON under your data directory (~/Library/Application Support/dupli/sessions on macOS, ~/.local/share/dupli/sessions on Linux).

Resuming

dupli -c                # continue the most recent session
dupli --session <id>    # resume a specific one

Or from inside Dupli:

» /sessions
» /resume 18f2a1c9e4b-3f01

What’s saved

  • All messages (yours, the model’s, and action results)
  • The provider and model used
  • The session title (taken from your first prompt)

Rewinding with /navigate truncates the saved history too, so a resumed session picks up exactly where you left off.

Files

Sessions are plain JSON — you can open, diff, or copy them. The id is timestamp-based so sessions sort naturally in /sessions.
